desc:
The official successor to Urbanmove 2. This game is a bus simulator and a tram simulator in one. You can do anything you want with your vehicle. Drive it on a route of your choice, or roleplay with your friends.

Don't worry, an update is being worked on! We're sorry for how long it's taking, but we believe it's going to be worth the wait. While we can't estimate the release date yet, stay tuned!
